title: Regression: @Inject mock service in QuarkusTest is null during JUnit @TestFactory execution in Quarkus 1.3.0.Final
body:
**Description**
When a JUnit test includes an `@Inject` mock service bean initialisation works properly for normal `@BeforeEach` and `@Test` annotated methods, but tests executed with `@TestFactory` have the mock service uninitialised.

In the attached sample project, look at ExampleResourceTest.`tests` for an example of the problem, these tests work properly in Quarkus 1.2.1.Final.

**Expected behavior**
The `@Inject` mock bean is initialised correctly during `@TestFactory` execution.

**Actual behavior**
The `@Inject` mock bean fails to be initialised.

`
[ERROR] tests[1]  Time elapsed: 0.154 s  <<< ERROR!
kotlin.UninitializedPropertyAccessException: lateinit property mockExternalService has not been initialized
        at org.acme.ExampleResourceTest.getMockExternalService(ExampleResourceTest.kt:13)
`

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. In the attached sample project, run ExampleResourceTest.`tests`
2. kotlin.UninitializedPropertyAccessException: lateinit property mockExternalService has not been initialized

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Output of `uname -a` or `ver`: 
`Darwin xxxx 18.7.0 Darwin Kernel Version 18.7.0: Thu Jan 23 06:52:12 PST 2020; root:xnu-4903.278.25~1/RELEASE_X86_64 x86_64`

`
